I would like to take this opportunity to highlight the "three sisters" that grow really well together which are corn beans and squash.

The corn acts as support for the beans which will climb the corn. The beans will provide the corn with vital nitrogen, introduced through the soil. Lastly the squash keeps the weeds at bay and retains moisture for the soil.

Beans and corn provide a balanced diet in unison.
